headline: United Rentals (URI) Raises Outlook Following Q2 Beat, Is The Upside Already Priced In?
summary: United Rentals (URI) reported second quarter 2026 earnings and revenue that beat estimates, then lifted its full-year revenue and adjusted EBITDA outlook, putting the stock back in focus for equipment rental investors.
